concept: Facing a real fear (public speaking, rejection, failure) instead of avoiding it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic situation involving a common teen fear (speaking in front of others, asking someone something risky, submitting creative work for judgment)
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to face the fear or avoid it, and sees a believable outcome either way
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what avoiding it would have cost versus what facing it did cost

assessment.success_marker: student compares the real cost of avoidance against the real cost of facing the fear, not just picking the 'brave' answer reflexively
